resource.name: Founder PM hire
resource.description: Eight-input diagnostic for founders. Collapses the two-step 'should I hire a PM?' + 'which level?' into one verdict: stay-founder-mode, not-yet (with interim playbook), hire-apm, hire-empowered-pm, or hire-head-of-product. Each verdict comes with what good looks like and the typical cost of getting it wrong.

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_diagnose
tools.description: Deterministic. Returns the verdict + interim_playbook_id from the eight inputs. Does not call an LLM.

interim_playbook_id.description: Optional. Omitted from the output when the verdict does not warrant an interim playbook (i.e., when an actual PM hire is recommended).

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_narrate
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Takes the diagnostic output and inputs, returns the three-section reading: verdict, level description (or interim playbook), wrong-fit cost.

user_inputs.description: The eight original inputs verbatim so the narration can reference specifics.

tools.name: founder_pm_hire_drift
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Compares the current diagnostic to a previous run and reports what shifted. Stores diagnostic inputs locally across runs.

_meta.dev.workingfromlenny.phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App; host's confirmation UI handles the consent surface.

_meta.dev.workingfromlenny.comment: MCP resource spec for the merged Founder PM hire app (supersedes #12 + #38). Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Validated against MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026 release + current draft) on 2026-05-18.

dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.summary: Narration tools in this app return a narration_brief, not the structured prose directly. The outputSchema(s) defined above describe the target rendering structure the host chat model is asked to produce. At runtime each narration tool returns { type: 'narration_brief', audience: 'user', directive, voice_rules, structure: { sections, per_section_template, length_cap }, inputs: <tool-specific>, corpus: { anchor_slug: chunk_text } }. The host chat model then renders the user-facing prose from the brief.
dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.worked_example: bundle/src/tools/pm-pitfalls/narrate.ts and bundle/src/shared/schemas.ts (PitfallNarrateOutput). Sonnet clones this pattern for every narration tool listed below.
dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.supersedes: Earlier 'host sampling + api_key fallback' design. Sampling/createMessage was not exposed by Claude Desktop or Claude Code CLI to user-installed extensions in 2026-05; Path 4 makes the host chat model the renderer, which is the MCP-recommended idiom.

dev.workingfromlenny.open_questions: Decide how the diagnose tool exposes the bias-toward-not-yet (early stages) and bias-away-from-head-of-product (non-heavy density) — debug logs in the tool output, or surface only in narration?
dev.workingfromlenny.proposed_answers: Surface only in narration. Debug-style bias annotations in the diagnose tool output leak implementation detail and can confuse hosts that render tool output verbatim. The founder_pm_hire_narrate tool is the right place to explain why the bias applies. If internal testing requires visibility into the routing logic, attach it under _meta with a reverse-DNS key (e.g., _meta['dev.workingfromlenny.debug_trace']) on the diagnose tool's output — _meta is the only metadata channel the spec actually defines, and reverse-DNS namespacing is the documented convention.
_meta.dev.workingfromlenny.outputSchema_refact: interim_playbook_id was changed from `type: ['string', 'null']` with `null` in the enum, to an optional string field omitted when not applicable. Absent fields are unambiguous; explicit nulls add a deserialization edge case for hosts.

notes: ui:// scheme is valid; no rigid format is enforced — server-defined slugs after the scheme are acceptable.

No requires-consent / data-retention / fs-write capability exists in either ext-apps appCapabilities or .mcpb manifest. Consent is host-discretion; readOnlyHint: false on stateful tools is the only normative hook.
Underscore-prefixed fields at non-_meta paths have undefined host behavior; project metadata lives under _meta with reverse-DNS keys.
interim_playbook_id refactored from nullable-enum to optional field; absent fields are unambiguous in the MCP output contract.
